scope: Exact delivered-B1/C13H2 family, representative350 cadence. Counts at wall include flight decays. Eventual N consists of arriving N14/N15/O14/O15; arriving N13 becomes C13. CSDA bins proxy stopping depth, not straggling or postimplant diffusion.

gas_N2_thresholds.scope: The threshold combines actual chemical liberation and cavity routing. N retained in the collection layer or isolated process loop contributes no cavity gas. The material remains recoverable station inventory.
